explanation.headline: Nafcillin sodium is not on FDA's shortage list; internal supply shows Corvale East at 3.5 days on hand for the 2 g/8 mL vial while Corvale General holds 25.8 days

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include nafcillin sodium as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 55 vials of the 2 g/8 mL presentation with a daily use of 15.9 vials, giving 3.5 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 402 vials of the same presentation with a daily use of 15.6 vials, giving 25.8 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 46 vials at 2.9 vials per day, providing 15.7 days on hand.
The ranked transfer option moves 168 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender with 15 days and the receiver with 14 days of supply.

The product label for NDC 55150012316 names Apitoria Pharma Private Limited (FEI 3004051616) as a registered plant with a VAI inspection ending 2025-12-12, Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) as a registered plant with an OAI inspection ending 2025-09-05, and Eugia SEZ Private Limited (FEI 3011905047) as a registered plant with a VAI inspection ending 2019-03-01.
No FDA shortage posting exists for this drug, so the buyer should execute the internal transfer and monitor the OAI classification at Aurobindo Pharma Limited for any future supply impact.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
